title: Will Phantom Blade Zero be #1 on Steam's Weekly Top Sellers - Top 100 products by revenue list for Oct 27 - Nov 3, 2026?
rules: If Phantom Blade Zero is ranked #1 on Steam's USA Weekly Top Sellers - Top 100 products by revenue list for Oct 27 - Nov 3, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with STEAM. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

blind.reasoning: Phantom Blade Zero launched Oct 28-29, inside the chart week. It hit about 731k concurrent Steam players and had already passed Modern Warfare 4 on the global top sellers chart before launch, so it is the favorite for global #1. The US revenue chart is less certain, because many of its players are likely in China. Modern Warfare 4 (in its second week) and the $1,049 Steam Machine could still beat it in US dollars.
blind.falsifier: Steam's US weekly chart for Oct 27 – Nov 3 shows Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 or the Steam Machine/Steam Deck at #1, with Phantom Blade Zero lower.

final.reasoning: The low price suggests traders see Modern Warfare 4 or Steam hardware leading the US revenue chart, which I couldn't verify, so I cut my estimate from 0.55 to 0.32. Phantom Blade Zero's 730k-player launch landing inside the chart week, while Modern Warfare 4 is in its second week, still leaves my estimate slightly above the market's 0.26 ask.
